attacks.name: Raptor Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Skyline Hunter
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it |!movement_medium|.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Abduct
superPowers.body: During its Activation, when this character begins a move action within |!range| 2 of an enemy character, it may use this superpower. After this move action is resolved, Place the enemy character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Scientific Hubris
superPowers.body: Whenever this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least one |!critical|.
